note_text:
CC: painful callus on the foot

HPI: weeks of symptoms relating to multiple thickened painful nails. Sensory neuropathy noted on prior visits. Peripheral vascular disease noted.

Exam: nails examined consistent with multiple thickened painful nails; no other findings recorded.

MDM: discussed risks and benefits of the planned procedure; patient consents.

Procedure: Debridement of 6 or more thickened nails performed with sterile technique. Tolerated well, no immediate complications.
